summary: Verify signed deployment GO receipts offline against the local replica and immutable packaged signer policy, without activating installers.

replay.detail: Verification reads existing claims, signature authorization and local synchronization receipts. No new projection or replay.

schema.detail: Add a strict version-1 packaged policy and read-only GO verification request/receipt contract, including future-origin timestamp diagnostics (futureDatedCount and maxFutureSkewMs). Existing deployment claim shapes, including combined STOP/plan bindings and required top-level previewDigest, are unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or claim retention changes.

compatibility.detail: The new deploy verify-go command requires a local Unix daemon and refuses missing, unreadable or unsupported packaged policy. Existing commands and claim kinds retain their behavior.

manual.detail: Package an immutable deployPolicyFile to enable authorization; there is no runtime, environment or CLI policy path override. Signed history is a ratchet, not a clock oracle: trusted_now is the maximum of local now and the newest authenticated active GO-origin timestamp no later than local now plus two minutes; absent eligible evidence falls back to local now. All issue, expiry and sync-freshness comparisons use trusted_now. Own-node signed history more than two minutes ahead, or the GO's own issue/signature time more than two minutes ahead, returns deploy-clock-untrusted with reason behind before other time checks. Other future-origin facts are excluded and reported diagnostically, not refused. Quiet origins may refresh unchanged sync receipts indefinitely; a successful GO-origin receipt within ten minutes remains required. Residual risk: clock rollback without newer own-node or eligible origin evidence can go undetected. This cooperative same-user auditable control requires operational host time synchronization; fresh origin-signed time exchange is outside this offline verifier.

recovery.detail: Same-operation consumption permits read-only replay with consumed=true in the receipt; other-operation consumption, wrong signer or wrong origin refuses authorization. Expired, revoked, mismatched, stale or STOP-blocked GOs fail closed. Verification does not synchronize, issue claims or mutate deployment state.

downtime.detail: No measured downtime claim. Installer wiring remains absent.
